calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.sub: Appointments as evidence for your stops
calendar.help: TravStats only reads the days the scan is looking at (at most 30 days back). An appointment that fits a stop in time and place becomes evidence in the suggestion. No other appointment is stored.

removeConfirm.title: Remove calendar “{{label}}”?
removeConfirm.after: Open suggestions lose the evidence from this calendar. Accepted visits stay.

blocked.internet_off: The server's internet access is switched off. No calendar is read.
blocked.service_off: The admin switched calendars off on this server. No calendar is read.

test.skipped_one: {{count}} recurring appointment was cut short or skipped (too many or invalid repetitions).
test.skipped_other: {{count}} recurring appointments were cut short or skipped (too many or invalid repetitions).

privacy.title: What is stored
privacy.sub: Only an appointment that fits a stop, with title, time and place, inside the suggestion. Once accepted or rejected only its time and calendar remain. The calendar's address and password are stored encrypted and never shown again.

form.label: Name
form.labelHint: e.g. Work or Private. Rules can refer to this calendar.
form.icsHint: The subscription address from iCloud, Google or Outlook. It is the key to the calendar and is stored encrypted.
form.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

failure.unknown: That did not work. Please try again later.

kind.notConfigured: The calendar is not fully set up.
kind.unreachable: The calendar server cannot be reached.
kind.auth: Access refused. Check the address, user or password. iCloud and Google require an app-specific password, not your normal account password.
kind.notFound: There is no calendar at this address.
kind.protocol: The server did not send a readable calendar answer.

code.PRIVATE_TARGET: This address is on the local network. Only the admin account may use a server on the local network.
code.CALENDAR_TIMEOUT: The calendar server did not answer in time.
code.CALENDAR_TOO_LARGE: The calendar is larger than 5 MB.
code.CALENDAR_TOO_MANY_EVENTS: The calendar has more than 10,000 appointments.
code.CALENDAR_PARSE: The answer is not a readable calendar (perhaps a login page).
code.CALENDAR_PARSE_TIMEOUT: The calendar could not be read in the time allowed.
code.CALENDAR_REDIRECT: The server redirects. TravStats follows no redirect; please enter the final address.
code.CALENDAR_XML_TOO_DEEP: The CalDAV server's answer is nested too deeply.
code.CALENDAR_FOREIGN_HREF: The CalDAV server points to another server. That is not followed.
code.CALENDAR_NO_COLLECTIONS: No calendar with appointments was found on this server.
code.CALENDAR_EGRESS_INTERNET_OFF: The server's internet access is switched off.
code.CALENDAR_EGRESS_SERVICE_OFF: The admin switched calendars off on this server.
code.CALENDAR_HTTPS_REQUIRED: Please use an https address. Over http the address and password would travel readable.
code.CALENDAR_UNSAFE_TIMEZONE: The calendar contains a time zone with invalid rules and is not read.

failure.network: The TravStats server could not be reached. Check the connection and test again.
failure.rateLimited: Too many tests in a short time. Please try again in a few minutes.

geocode.title: Appointment places
geocode.label: Look calendar places up for matching
geocode.sub: Off: appointments match only through own places, the place found at the stop, or a rule's place.
geocode.help: On: the place of an appointment a rule selects is looked up with the server's geocoder to match it to a stop. Only for stops outside your privacy zones. The text is neither stored nor logged.
geocode.error: The setting could not be saved. Please try again.

match.geocoded: The appointment's place is {{meters}} m from the stop.
match.placeName: The appointment's place names this place.
match.context: Only the time fits, no place: the appointment suggests the purpose at most.

time.startNear: The stop starts within an hour of the appointment's start

plugins.title: Suggestions from plugins
plugins.pending: A plugin has not answered yet; it will be asked again.
plugins.reasked: The plugins will be asked again on the next scan.
plugins.reaskError: That did not work. Please try again.

rules.title: Rules
rules.sub: What a matching appointment suggests as purpose and name
rules.help: Top to bottom, the first matching rule applies. Without a rule an appointment suggests its title as name and no purpose.
rules.error: The rules could not be saved. Please try again.
rules.placeHint: For appointments without a location: this own place, when it is beside the stop.

plugins.title: External suggestion sources
plugins.sub: Own services that answer stops with places
plugins.help: A plugin is an HTTPS service you run yourself or trust. TravStats asks it, signed, about a stop; its answer appears as a suggestion in the inbox. A plugin never writes into TravStats itself. Guide: docs/features/plugins.md.

blocked.internet_off: The server's internet access is switched off. No plugin is asked.
blocked.service_off: The admin switched plugins off on this server. No plugin is asked.

form.name: Name
form.urlHint: Only the admin account may add a service on the local network or over http.

secret.once: The secret for this plugin. It is shown only now: enter it in the plugin.
secret.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Please select it by hand.

test.empty: Answer in {{ms}} ms, version {{version}}: nothing at this place.

backfill.range: At most 90 days, not in the future.
backfill.running: Running … this can take a while because of the hourly limits.
backfill.done: Done: {{days}} days, {{asked}} requests, {{created}} new and {{merged}} extended suggestions, {{failed}} errors.
backfill.stopped: Stopped by the limits at {{at}}; starting again continues there.

sent.title: What is sent
sent.sub: A stop's start and end, its coordinates rounded to the chosen precision and its time zone; plus what TravStats already knows: the nearest own place, the place found and (at exact and 100 m) the address.
sent.help: Never sent: your account, name or e-mail, the location history, other stops or entries. Every request is signed with the secret.

removeConfirm.title: Remove plugin “{{name}}”?
removeConfirm.after: Its suggestions in open findings disappear. Accepted visits stay.

failure.unknown: That did not work. Please try again later.

reason.timeout: The plugin did not answer in time (5 s).
reason.auth: The plugin refused the request. Is the secret right?
reason.rateLimited: The plugin or the hourly limit allows no request right now.
reason.protocol: The plugin's answer does not fit the contract (version 1).
reason.server: The plugin reported a server error.
reason.privateTarget: This address is on the local network. Only the admin account may use it.
reason.readOnly: The plugin's archive does not allow writing (token without write permission).
reason.changed: The entry was changed in the archive since; undo is no longer possible.
reason.notFound: The plugin does not know this entry (any more).
reason.notReady: The plugin is still loading its archive. Please try again shortly.
reason.unsupported: This plugin does not offer location maintenance.

code.PRIVATE_TARGET: This address is on the local network. Only the admin account may use it.
code.PLUGIN_BACKFILL_REFUSED: Asking about past days is not allowed for this plugin, or the range is longer than 90 days.
code.PLUGIN_BACKFILL_RUNNING: A request for this plugin is already running.
code.SERVICE_DISABLED: Plugins are switched off on this server.
code.PLUGIN_NO_MAINTENANCE: This plugin does not offer location maintenance.

stopsWithheld.travtrackOff: No stops sent: TravTrack is not this account's location source.

maintenance.searchFailed: The address search is not reachable right now.
